def render(report):
    """Convert a report to a Markdown table."""
    word_count = report['word_count']
    distinct_words = report['distinct_words']
    top_words = report['top_words']

    top_words_str = ', '.join(f"{word} ({count})" for word, count in top_words)

    return f"""| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Word count | {word_count} |
| Distinct words | {distinct_words} |
| Top words | {top_words_str} |"""
